create_drawer_task: create a Drawer task instance that loads the drawer MJCF model and adds it to the simulation scene
initialize_drawer_episode: initialize a drawer episode by placing the drawer prop at a randomized position and rotation
review_drawer_position_distribution: review the drawer_position Uniform distribution that randomizes drawer placement within a 0.3x0.3 meter area
review_drawer_rotation_distribution: review the drawer_rotation QuaternionFromAxisAngle distribution that randomizes drawer yaw within plus or minus 45 degrees
refactor_drawer_extra_dofs: refactor the Drawer class to adjust the extra degrees of freedom for the drawer model
